sql: SELECT judgment_year, CASE WHEN verdict = 'Dismissed' THEN 'Dismissed' ELSE 'not_dismissed' END AS dismissal_status, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 GROUP BY judgment_year, dismissal_status

SELECT hearing_year, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, MAX(case_number) AS max_precedents, SUM(CASE WHEN verdict = 'Approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count FROM legal WHERE hearing_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hearing_year

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, first_judge, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE first_judge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY case_family, first_judge
SELECT evidence, first_judge, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE evidence IS NOT NULL AND first_judge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY evidence, first_judge

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant != '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE nationality_for_applicant != '' GROUP BY applicant_nation, case_family

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant != '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE nationality_for_applicant != '' GROUP BY applicant_nation, verdict_family

SELECT judgment_year, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents, SUM(CASE WHEN evidence = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS evidence_count FROM legal WHERE judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY judgment_year

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, CASE WHEN case_number >= 8 THEN 'precedent_heavy' ELSE 'precedent_light' END AS precedent_band, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY case_family, precedent_band
SELECT judge_name, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE judge_name != '' GROUP BY judge_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10

SELECT CASE WHEN plaintiff_current_status IN ('Company', 'Organization', 'Government') THEN plaintiff_current_status WHEN plaintiff_current_status != '' THEN 'Individual_or_other' END AS plaintiff_family, CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE plaintiff_current_status != '' GROUP BY plaintiff_family, verdict_family

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant != '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE nationality_for_applicant != '' AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY applicant_nation

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY case_family, verdict_family HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal GROUP BY case_family, verdict_family

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant != '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, COUNT(*) AS case_count, SUM(CASE WHEN verdict = 'Dismissed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes FROM legal WHERE nationality_for_applicant != '' GROUP BY applicant_nation

SELECT judge_name, CASE WHEN verdict = 'Dismissed' THEN 'Dismissed' ELSE 'not_dismissed' END AS dismissal_status, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE judge_name IN ('Flick', 'Tracey', 'Greenwood', 'Marshall', 'Moore', 'Heerey') GROUP BY judge_name, dismissal_status

SELECT CASE WHEN defendant_current_status IN ('Government', 'Company', 'Organization') THEN defendant_current_status WHEN defendant_current_status != '' THEN 'Other' END AS defendant_family, CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE defendant_current_status != '' GROUP BY defendant_family, verdict_family

SELECT CASE WHEN plaintiff_current_status IN ('Company', 'Organization', 'Government') THEN plaintiff_current_status WHEN plaintiff_current_status != '' THEN 'Individual_or_other' END AS plaintiff_family, CASE WHEN defendant_current_status IN ('Government', 'Company', 'Organization') THEN defendant_current_status WHEN defendant_current_status != '' THEN 'Other' END AS defendant_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE plaintiff_current_status != '' AND defendant_current_status != '' GROUP BY plaintiff_family, defendant_family

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India') GROUP BY case_family

SELECT CASE WHEN case_number = 0 THEN 'none' WHEN case_number <= 4 THEN '1_to_4' ELSE '5_or_more' END AS precedent_band, case_type, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY precedent_band, case_type

SELECT CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Commercial Case' AND case_number >= 3 GROUP BY verdict_family
